entities.summary: Thomas Numme (b. 1970-02-28, Sandefjord) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sandefjord and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
